metadata.article_title: Domicile acquired by woman on marriage.

article.title: Domicile acquired by woman on marriage.
article.content: By marriage a woman acquires the domicile of her husband, if she had not the same domicile before.
article.html:
15Domicile acquired by woman on marriage.

Section 15 · Part II · page 19 of the Act

By marriage a woman acquires the domicile of her husband, if she had not the same domicile before.
